nodes.label: design/ds-source is the pixel-perfect source of truth
nodes.rationale: Where any doc and the vendored CSS disagree, the CSS wins; _ds_manifest.json is inventory only and never a source of values because it snapshotted the 1ms reduced-motion durations as canonical.

nodes.label: Token Pipeline — packages/tokens GENERATES from vendored CSS
nodes.rationale: Never hand-transcribe: the package's own manifest proves re-transcription drifts. Token names survive verbatim because the mockups reference them and renaming breaks pixel-perfect traceability.

nodes.label: Marked Token Extensions (Devanagari face, semibold, brand-wash, viz namespaces, AA overrides)
nodes.rationale: Each extension is emitted under an explicit marker so ds-source diffs stay clean; extension 6 is the only one that CHANGES a ds-source value rather than adding one, because both colours failed AA for text in shipped components.

nodes.label: Contrast Build Gate (DECLARED_PAIRS + coverage from component usage)
nodes.rationale: Contrast is computed, never eyeballed, and coverage is derived from component usage so a pairing nobody declared fails the build rather than going unchecked. Floors come from the role's WCAG requirement, never the measured value, which would weaken the gate to pass.

nodes.label: Brand Law (neutrals are the product, near-black primary action)
nodes.rationale: Restraint is the premium signal: iridescence is atmosphere only, hierarchy comes from luminance and softness rather than lines, and overlays blur toward white rather than using a dark scrim.

nodes.label: Light-Only v1 (owner ruling A)
nodes.rationale: The ds system is light-only by law and by fact (zero dark tokens, color-scheme:light); the semantic-alias indirection is kept so a dark value set is a later drop-in with no component rewrite. The 'studio canvas stays dark' doctrine is dead.

nodes.label: 21-Component API of packages/ui (prop enums are the contract)
nodes.rationale: The ds JSX library is spec to implement, not code to import; Radix supplies a11y plumbing underneath while the visual layer is pure token-driven styling, and typed prop enums make violations compile errors rather than lint warnings.

nodes.label: Four Behavioural Contracts (NumberField, DataTable caption, ariaLabel, focus)
nodes.rationale: The BOM and quote are commercial documents, so no anonymous tables; NumberField commits on blur because keystroke commits break precise numeric entry on mobile keyboards.

nodes.label: Lingui One-Catalog Architecture (packages/i18n)
nodes.rationale: Locale resolves per-USER rather than per-tenant so a Marathi surveyor and an English owner coexist in one tenant; missing translations fall back to English at runtime, never a bare key and never a crash.

nodes.label: Devanagari Typography Chain (Geist → Noto Sans Devanagari)
nodes.rationale: Geist has zero Devanagari coverage and RN has no per-codepoint fallback to bundled fonts, so an AppText primitive detects the U+0900–U+097F range and applies Noto per run; OS fallback is unacceptable for a pixel-perfect commercial product.

nodes.label: Formatting Law (formatInr, units never translated, Latin digits)
nodes.rationale: One money function everywhere — web, mobile, PDFs and voice-agent text — because raw Intl.NumberFormat would fragment Indian grouping across surfaces.

nodes.label: Per-Screen Definition of Done (12 items)
nodes.rationale: Applies unreduced to the 3D studio: full parity at 375px is the hardest and least negotiable commitment in the system.

nodes.label: N1–N10 Interaction & Accessibility Law
nodes.rationale: Promoted verbatim from the POC design brief when the 'Instrument' visual identity was retired; cited by number from several docs, so the numbering is fixed — never renumber, never reword an N-rule.

nodes.label: Mobile/Touch Contract (one canvas gesture vocabulary)
nodes.rationale: Build for pointer events and branch on capability, never on screen width; numeric entry is always available as the accessible and precise path beside every gesture.

nodes.label: Per-Tenant Branding — customer documents ONLY
nodes.rationale: Tenants brand what their customers see but never restyle the app, so every screenshot, support session and training video stays identical across tenants; palettes are never rejected — compliant shades are derived by computation and previewed live.

nodes.label: Adherence & Lint Intents (gated vs reviewed)
nodes.rationale: Raw hex is gated because it has a syntactic tell; arbitrary px and font-family are reviewed rather than gated because a grep there would be almost entirely false positives or 100% exemptions.
